steps.caption: Цикълът чете множеството всеки кадър и движи героя.
steps.code:
<style>body{margin:0}</style>
<canvas width="400" height="200" style="background:#111827"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.querySelector("canvas");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const keys = new Set();
addEventListener("keydown", (e) => keys.add(e.code));
addEventListener("keyup", (e) => keys.delete(e.code));

const hero = { x: 40, y: 80 };
let last = 0;

function frame(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.1);
  last = now;
  if (keys.has("ArrowRight")) hero.x += 150 * dt;
  if (keys.has("ArrowDown")) hero.y += 150 * dt;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#111827";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 400, 200);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#22d3ee";
  ctx.fillRect(hero.x, hero.y, 30, 30);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame((t) => { last = t; frame(t); });
</script>

steps.caption: event.code е физическата клавиша: A работи и на българска подредба.
steps.code:
<style>body{margin:0}</style>
<canvas width="400" height="200" style="background:#111827"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.querySelector("canvas");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const keys = new Set();
addEventListener("keydown", (e) => keys.add(e.code));
addEventListener("keyup", (e) => keys.delete(e.code));

const hero = { x: 40, y: 80 };
let last = 0;

function frame(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.1);
  last = now;
  if (keys.has("ArrowRight")) hero.x += 150 * dt;
  if (keys.has("ArrowDown")) hero.y += 150 * dt;
  if (keys.has("ArrowLeft") || keys.has("KeyA")) hero.x -= 150 * dt;
  hero.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(370, hero.x));
  ctx.fillStyle = "#111827";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 400, 200);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#22d3ee";
  ctx.fillRect(hero.x, hero.y, 30, 30);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame((t) => { last = t; frame(t); });
</script>
